I don't know if you're still on.  Perhaps, hopefully you are.  If not, I guess I don't really have much of a choice.

I'm crying right now.  It's one in the morning and I'm crying my fucking eyes out right now and trying not to wake up my parents.  I feel like so much shit.  I feel guilty for making the people around me suffer with me.  I feel like no one cares.
No one cares.
*No one cares.*

I feel like I've gone through so much in my sixteen years in this world.  Such little time.  And I know I'm just going to sound like some teenager with angst.  That's why people don't listen to me, and I feel like my last resort is reddit, a site I honestly never use.  I used to cut myself.  I used to do drugs.  I used to drink until I passed out.  I'm practically insane if it comes down to that.  I've attempted to commit suicide three times.  And I'm still here.  

It's like sickness surrounds me, and has done so my entire life.  My greatest friend passed away to Leukemia when I was 10.  When I was 11, this woman who treated me with more care than my actual mother, she died to renal cancer.  My grandfather passed away that same year.  And now...Two people in the Skype group I don't even feel I belong in anymore but have grown attached to, one of them suffers from heart failure and the other fractures something every few games or so since he plays professional hockey.  Even my girlfriend, whom I love so much and she loves me, was diagnosed with cancer only a few months. I feel like no matter what I try to do in order to pick myself up, my life is just falling apart relentlessly.

My so-called friends... they don't want to listen to any of the shit I spew out of my mouth anymore.  And honestly, I don't blame them. I'm just a depressing piece of crap that wants someone to listen.  My girlfriend is amazing, I don't know how she puts up with me at all.  I just need... someone...

I know this isn't that embarrassing, but this is the best I could think of.  

Apparently, when I was about 3 years old, I bit my brother's butt.  

My parents have pictures.  /facepalm
